facts.text: Jon's dance crew won first place in a local competition last year, as evidenced by a photograph of Jon in a suit performing a dance.

evidence.quote: Wow, I'm excited too! This is gonna be great! [image: a photography of a man in a suit is performing a dance]
that pic's from when my dance crew took home first in a local comp last year.

facts.text: Jon expressed enthusiasm about sharing the intensity of his dance crew's performance with others.

evidence.quote: I'm super keen to spread that intensity with other peeps.

facts.text: Gina mentioned she used to compete in dance competitions and shows, with a favorite memory of winning first place at a regional competition at age fifteen.

evidence.quote: I used to compete in a few dance competitions and shows - my fav memory was when my team won first place at a regionals at age fifteen.
